BiblicalUsage: The word is drowsiness, sleep. The proverb says, Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids, when a debt is owed; and, Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep, and poverty comes. The psalmist vows, I will not give sleep to mine eyes, nor slumber to mine eyelids, until I find a place for the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that sleep is the thief of the diligent and the vow of the zealous, and the difference is what keeps you awake.
